title: Crossover Filter
text: Audio crossover filter, 9 inputs, 5 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Number of crossovers} sets the number of magnitude response band, {Crossover frequency (Hz)} sets the intersections of magnitude response bands, {Crossover order} sets the order of individual crossover filters, {View filter response} sets the open plot of magnitude response of each filter band, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists}, {Export filter to workspace}, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: F1
ports.summary: Crossover frequency (Hz) real scalar in the range 20 to 20000

ports.name: O1

params.values: Number of magnitude response band crossings 1 (default) | 2 | 3 | 4
